game.title: Pokémon Crystal
game.revision_note: US Crystal shipped as v1.0 and v1.1. None of the sources for these codes distinguish between them — if a code misbehaves, that may be why.

codes.name: Infinite Money
codes.description: Sets money to the maximum (999,999). If this 6-line version misbehaves, the documented Crystal-specific core is the last three lines alone.
side_effects: Enable one cheat at a time; save before activating and disable the cheat before saving again.

codes.name: Rare Candy in bag slot 1
codes.description: Turns whatever item is in the first Items-pocket slot into Rare Candy, keeping its quantity.
codes.activation: Put a cheap stackable item in bag slot 1 first
side_effects: Replaces the item currently in bag slot 1 — one player reported key items disappearing; keep a backup save.

codes.name: Buy Master Balls at Poké Mart
codes.description: Makes Master Ball the first item sold at any Poké Mart, in unlimited supply.
side_effects: Replaces the mart's normal first item while active — disable after buying.

codes.name: Shiny Wild Pokémon
codes.description: Forces wild encounters to be shiny. If it doesn't trigger, sources note the 01-prefix form (010730D2) has worked where this one didn't.
side_effects: You cannot run away from battles while this code is active — disable after catching.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls
codes.description: Walk through walls, trees, water and other collision. The last four lines are the documented original; the 8-line form is what modern sources publish.
side_effects: Can freeze the game in certain map areas — save before enabling, disable before going through doors.
